newsitem.title: UK: Wagon to sell retail systems for 33 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Wagon to sell retail systems for 33 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Wagon Industrial Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it was selling its retail systems division to German firm Linde AG for about 33 million stg.
The company said the price represented a premium of 15.5 million stg to its net asset value.
Wagon Industrial said the proceeds would be invested in the group's core business of automotive components, precision engineering and storage products.
Wagon's chairman David Kendall said, "The board is very pleased with the terms of the disposal which will realise significant value for Wagon's shareholders."
The company underwent a review of operations since Kendall took over as chairman last January and the sale is part of its decision to focus on its core engineering competencies.
